reason: Executive summary generated from the resolved incident group.
summary: Severe weather at Bengaluru (VOBL) on 20 August 2026 disrupted 8 departures, affecting 604 passengers, 22 onward connections, 9 crew rotations and requiring 303 hotel rooms across the network event. The disruption was detected, assessed, and resolved through the automated recovery system with one operator intervention (bulk notification approval). Total committed accommodation cost: INR 2,76,600.

sections.heading: Disruption scope
sections.body: A thunderstorm cell over VOBL from 14:00 IST caused visibility below 800m and sustained winds of 24kt with gusts to 38kt. Eight scheduled departures were delayed beyond their minimum connection thresholds, triggering a network cascade across four domestic destinations.

sections.heading: Passenger impact
sections.body: 604 passengers were affected. 22 held onward connections that became infeasible. 174 passengers on the primary flight required overnight accommodation. 15 passengers were assessed as elevated priority due to recorded special needs. No passenger was scored on factors that had not been established by a service.

sections.heading: Recovery actions
sections.body: 5 deterministic services executed across the recovery: connection assessment, hotel search, hotel allocation (partial — 71 of 87 rooms, 16 short), crew impact assessment, and passenger notification. Each was individually authorised by the Decision Assurance Gate. The bulk notification (high risk tier) required and received explicit operator approval.

sections.heading: Accommodation
sections.body: 6 partner hotels within the INR 7,500 rate cap held 71 rooms against the 87 required for 174 passengers at 2 per room. 16-room shortfall reported and flagged. Total committed cost INR 2,76,600. The inventory hold is recorded in the ledger and matches the blast radius figure.

sections.heading: Resolution
sections.body: All 8 member incidents reached resolved state. The group cascade shows 46 nodes and 46 edges, each with provenance tracing to a recorded action or prediction. No figure on the executive display was computed client-side; all are derived server-side from persisted evidence.
